data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 30.3 million in 2024, representing a 3.3% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This overall release occurred despite adverse development related to the ongoing Ukraine war, which led to a strengthening of reserves for the 2021 year of account. The overall favorable development implies larger releases from other prior underwriting years or lines of business.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure from the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' note (-GBP 30.3m release) differs from the calculation based on the gross claims development triangle (+GBP 21.0m strengthening). The explicit note figure is used as the primary source. The impact of the Ukraine war on prior year reserves is described as adverse development (strengthening) for the 2021 year of account, but the specific monetary amount of this strengthening in 2024 is not quantified.
